title: After a passing PR run, main skips the whole push run
ruling: Owner 16:03 CST Nov 13, to the consultant, page item 769 pick a, reading 1 of his own two-way text ("a1 (recommended)"): "main skips the whole run after a passing PR run. Gain: most merges run no jobs on main. Lose: a suite the change didn't touch isn't re-run until a later change touches it." That is reading 2: after a green PR run, narrowed or full, lone lane or combined, main runs none of its suites for that merge. His 15:59 text ("Main runs only the suites the PR skipped") is superseded by this. Extends ruling push-skip-proven-tree (729 a) to a narrowed PR run. A direct push still runs its suites.
quote: a1 (recommended): main skips the whole run after a passing PR run.
source: Owner chat with the consultant 16:03 CST Nov 13, relayed 16:04 CST; filed by triage. Ruling r62 part 3 does not rule it (it speaks of a batch PR run).
